You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 

Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From 81f954a44567567c7d74a97b1db78fb43afc253d Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Martin Varghese <martin.varghese@nokia.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2020 08:33:51 +0530
Subject: [PATCH] bareudp: Fixed bareudp receive handling

Reverted commit "2baecda bareudp: remove unnecessary udp_encap_enable() in
bareudp_socket_create()"

An explicit call to udp_encap_enable is needed as the setup_udp_tunnel_sock
does not call udp_encap_enable if the if the socket is of type v6.

Bareudp device uses v6 socket to receive v4 & v6 traffic

CC: Taehee Yoo <ap420073@gmail.com>
Fixes: 2baecda37f4e ("bareudp: remove unnecessary udp_encap_enable() in bareudp_socket_create()")
Signed-off-by: Martin Varghese <martin.varghese@nokia.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

diff --git a/drivers/net/bareudp.c b/drivers/net/bareudp.c
index 71a2f480f70e..cc0703c3d57f 100644
--- a/drivers/net/bareudp.c
+++ b/drivers/net/bareudp.c
@@ -250,6 +250,12 @@ static int bareudp_socket_create(struct bareudp_dev *bareudp, __be16 port)
 	tunnel_cfg.encap_destroy = NULL;
 	setup_udp_tunnel_sock(bareudp->net, sock, &tunnel_cfg);
 
+	/* As the setup_udp_tunnel_sock does not call udp_encap_enable if the
+	 * socket type is v6 an explicit call to udp_encap_enable is needed.
+	 */
+	if (sock->sk->sk_family == AF_INET6)
+		udp_encap_enable();
+
 	rcu_assign_pointer(bareudp->sock, sock);
 	return 0;
 }
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/net/bareudp.c`**
- Reverted the previous commit that removed the call to `udp_encap_enable()` in the `bareudp_socket_create()` function.
- Added an explicit call to `udp_encap_enable()` when the socket type is IPv6 (`AF_INET6`). This is necessary because the `setup_udp_tunnel_sock()` function does not enable UDP encapsulation for IPv6 sockets.

### Relationships
The modification in `bareudp.c` directly addresses a bug introduced by the earlier commit (identified by the hash `2baecda`). The previous change removed the call to `udp_encap_enable()`, which was found to be necessary for proper handling of IPv6 sockets in the context of the bareudp device. The current patch reinstates this call to ensure that both IPv4 and IPv6 traffic can be received correctly by the bareudp device.

2. output the file name that is most likely to cause the bug.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
setup_udp_tunnel_sock(bareudp->net, sock, &tunnel_cfg);
```
```c
// No explicit call to udp_encap_enable() for IPv6 sockets
```
Reason:
The removal of the explicit call to `udp_encap_enable()` in the `bareudp_socket_create()` function resulted in the failure to enable UDP encapsulation for IPv6 sockets. Since `setup_udp_tunnel_sock()` does not enable UDP encapsulation for IPv6, this omission caused the bareudp device to improperly handle incoming IPv6 traffic, affecting its ability to receive both IPv4 and IPv6 packets correctly.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
if (sock->sk->sk_family == AF_INET6)
    udp_encap_enable();
```
Reason:
This addition explicitly calls `udp_encap_enable()` for IPv6 sockets, ensuring that UDP encapsulation is properly enabled. This fix restores the necessary functionality for the bareudp device to handle both IPv4 and IPv6 traffic correctly, addressing the issue caused by the previous removal of the call.
